# Pomo Cowork

> Pomo Cowork is a browser-based Pomodoro timer and online coworking workspace for focused work and study. It combines configurable focus sessions and breaks with tasks, live coworker presence, rooms, and progress tracking.

Canonical website: https://pomo-co.work. The main timer can be started as a guest. Account and Pro features depend on the options shown in the app; consult the pricing page for current plans. Specialized tools include study timers, fixed-duration timers, and study planners.

The expanded Markdown overview below explains the product without requiring JavaScript. Other links lead to public web pages. This is a curated guide; the sitemap provides broader URL coverage. Personal workspace data and private rooms are not part of this guide.

## Product overview

- [Expanded product guide](https://pomo-co.work/llms-full.txt): Markdown overview of capabilities, workflows, tools, and common questions.
- [Pomo Cowork workspace](https://pomo-co.work/): Main timer, tasks, background sounds, and live coworker presence.
- [Coworking rooms](https://pomo-co.work/rooms): Find or create a shared workspace.
- [Pricing](https://pomo-co.work/pricing): Current free and Pro features and subscription terms.

## Focus and study tools

- [Pomodoro timer](https://pomo-co.work/pomodoro-timer): Classic focus and break cycles, with an explanation of the technique.
- [Study timer](https://pomo-co.work/study-timer): Timed study sessions and planned breaks.
- [Deep work timer](https://pomo-co.work/deep-work-timer): Focus blocks for sustained work.
- [Aesthetic Pomodoro timer](https://pomo-co.work/aesthetic-pomodoro-timer): Pomodoro sessions with a customizable visual environment.
- [25/5 Pomodoro](https://pomo-co.work/25-5-pomodoro): A 25-minute focus and five-minute break pattern.
- [50/10 Pomodoro](https://pomo-co.work/50-10-pomodoro): A 50-minute focus and ten-minute break pattern.
- [Active recall timer](https://pomo-co.work/active-recall-timer): Timed practice for retrieving information from memory.

## Working together

- [Pomodoro with friends](https://pomo-co.work/pomodoro-with-friends): Shared company while working through focus sessions.
- [Online study room](https://pomo-co.work/online-study-room): A starting point for studying alongside others online.
- [Virtual coworking room](https://pomo-co.work/virtual-coworking-room): Online coworking for independent tasks.

## Planning

- [Weekly study planner](https://pomo-co.work/weekly-study-planner): Plan study time around subjects, available days, and session lengths.
- [Exam study planner](https://pomo-co.work/exam-study-planner): Organize preparation around an exam and available study time.
- [Pomodoro calculator](https://pomo-co.work/pomodoro-calculator): Estimate a schedule of focus sessions and breaks.

## Practical guides

- [Blog](https://pomo-co.work/blog): Guides to focused work, Pomodoro sessions, study planning, and online coworking.
- [Using the Pomodoro technique](https://pomo-co.work/blog/pomodoro-technique-guide): Choose a task, manage interruptions, and take breaks.
- [Running an online coworking session](https://pomo-co.work/blog/how-to-run-online-coworking-session): Set an agenda, work independently, and use check-ins.
- [Making a weekly study plan](https://pomo-co.work/blog/how-to-make-weekly-study-plan): Plan realistic availability, practice, and recovery after missed work.
